data.content: Our cooperation with GIZ (Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit) and The German Embassy in Kosovo spans across various fields, from branding to design.
Logo, poster and various designs, including an animated video for social media, for the Days of the German Language event held during June and July 2021 in Kosovo.
We won the logo competition celebrating 20 years of friendship and cooperation between Germany and Kosova. The race was to design the best logo in 24 hours.
It depicts the flags of both countries in the shape a heart, number 20 and a flamingo bird, the symbol of togetherness.
We were assigned the task to design the annual reports from 2015 to 2019, following the specific corporate guidelines.
